en: We're on the air twenty-four hours a day. If the shows never sleep, neither do I!
A Trainer's Pokémon is a partner, not a tool. Team Rocket wants to bend them to its will. It's monstrous.
Their boss has shut himself away upstairs, past the shutters. Only the Director could open them, and he's on the fifth floor.
Is the Director all right? Please tell me he's safe...
You did it! You chased Team Rocket out of the tower! Here, please take this, with all our thanks.
TM11 is Sunny Day. It makes the sun blaze for a while, and Fire-type moves burn all the hotter.
You were wonderful. The whole tower is talking about you!
The shutter is locked. It must open with a Card Key.
It's a slot for a Card Key.
{player} slid the Card Key into the slot.
It's a slot for a Card Key. The shutter beside it stands open.
